title: Seasonal Desk Guide: Restore Payment for Idle Electric Service by Rate Schedule Accounts
content:
**Subject.** A member who asks to have an idle seasonal or irrigation account of Electric Service by Rate Schedule restored is told the restore payment, the amount the member pays on the spot so that the account carries no unpaid balance into the new season. The member makes that payment personally, on the cooperative's automated phone payment line.

**When the figure is fixed.** The restore payment is fixed only after the account carries the annual minimum adjustment line its closed season owes, dated after the account went idle.

**Observable effect of the payment.** The member's payment posts on the idle account as a card payment dated today and lowers the account's current balance by the amount paid.

## The member's phone payment line

**Situation of use and capability.** `pay_restore_balance_91f3e2ab` is the member's own card payment toward an idle seasonal or irrigation service account, on the cooperative's automated phone payment line. It is not the line for an account disconnected for nonpayment or for an account in service. One run posts a single card payment, dated today, to the account and lowers its current balance by the amount paid; the line reads back a confirmation number for the member to keep.

**How it is invoked.** This is a member-side tool: the representative unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it (through `call_user_discoverable_tool`) with the values the representative reads out.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `service_account_id` | The reference number of the idle electric service account (one metered location) being paid, as the representative reads it from the service account lookup | Identifier |
| `payment_amount` | The amount the member pays, exactly as the representative quotes it | USD, positive, 2 decimal places |

**Return.** On success the receipt carries `payment_id` (the reference number of the posted payment), `service_account_id`, `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places), `payment_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, today), `payment_channel` (always `phone_ivr_card`, the automated phone card line), `payment_reference` (the eight-digit confirmation number the line issues), `account_balance` (the new balance, USD with 2 decimal places) and `status`, which reads "posted" when the payment is on the account.

### Contract questions

**Who runs the payment line?** The member. The representative unlocks and hands over the tool; the customer themselves enters the payment.

**Is this the line for a disconnected account?** No. It serves idle seasonal and irrigation accounts only.
